remarks: Welcome to Chesterfield, Stamford's premier gated condo development! This beautifully renovated 1 bedroom/1.5 bath unit is set back from the road so you can enjoy the lush landscaping and wide, tree-lined streets that the complex offers. The gleaming eat-in kitchen has stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, under-counter lighting, and extra-height cabinets with beautiful molding. The wood-burning fireplace is the centerpiece of the living room, which opens to a private deck with stairs so you can enjoy indoor/outdoor entertainment. The updated powder room and entrance with skylights complete the first floor. The second floor has wood flooring and features a loft area with skylights, perfect for working from home, or a reading nook. The spacious bedroom has 3 closets, an updated bathroom with a skylight, oversized vanity, and 2 sinks. The attic with pull-down stairs offers extra storage. Two pools - the main pool is saltwater, 24-hour security, and on-premise parking. Walk to shops, restaurants, parks, and transportation. New floor on the main level in 2020; hot water heater and HVAC updated in 2019.  Schedule a viewing today!
